title: Scalar Autograd Engine
signature: class Value: data, grad, __add__, __mul__, __pow__, __neg__, __sub__, __truediv__, __radd__, __rmul__, __rsub__, __rtruediv__, tanh(), relu(), exp(), backward()
hints: Each Value stores its data, its grad, the Values it came from, and a closure that pushes its grad back to them.
Gradients must ACCUMULATE (+=). A value used twice, like a * a, receives two contributions.
backward() has to visit nodes in reverse topological order. Build that order with a DFS from the output.
x / y can be written as x * y**-1, and x - y as x + (-y).
